     Double Materiality                                                                                                     Our integrated and balanced approach, aligned with our
     Prioritising for a Resilient                                                                                           long-term value creation goal, drives the development of
                                                                                                                            robust strategies. It enables us to effectively navigate
     and Sustainable Future                                                                                                 the evolving complexities of the business landscape while
                                                                                                                            reinforcing our commitment to sustainable growth.
     Our integrated approach to materiality is driven by our commitment towards
     ensuring a resilient, inclusive and sustainable future for all. Continuous engagement
     with the stakeholders, and a strong understanding of the issues that truly matter to
     them, empower AEL to drive holistic, sustainable and long-term value creation.                                      Materiality Assessment Process

                                                                                                                                The process of identification is followed by finalisation of the key issues. This is

                                                                                                                                any significant changes in our business nature or the material topics to all the

                                                                                                             Safety Without Reprisal
                                                                                                             The Adani Group Occupational Health & Safety Policy and Life Saving Safety
                                                                                                             Rules (LSSR) nurture a culture where everyone can report safety concerns
                                                                                                             without fear of reprisal. Employees and workers are empowered to stop
                                                                                                             their work if they observe unsafe working conditions. A QR-based reporting
                                                                                                             system enables anonymous and confidential reporting, protecting workers’
                                                                                                             identities. Our leadership team actively encourages open dialogue, ensuring
                                                                                                             everyone is aware of their rights, responsibilities and protection mechanisms.

 MAPS & WAYFINDING
 (IXE)
The ‘airport indoor maps and navigation solution for passengers’ is an innovative project aimed at
enabling them to seamlessly move around the airport, understand where they need to go, and use
the airport services and facilities with ease. It helps reduce the stress and anxiety associated with
travel. By leveraging interactive way-finding technology that uses existing signals, we not only
offer convenience and connectivity to airport passengers but also make their travelling experience
frictionless and memorable.
This solution is especially useful for people with reduced mobility, as it enables them to define routes
which have only elevators, ramps etc. This drives enhanced customer satisfaction, improved brand
perception, and higher visibility for POIs like F&B outlets, lounges and shopping areas.

                                                                                                                             A Lifeline of Care for Mrs. Shuwala Thapa
                                                                                                                             At 58, Mrs. Shuwala Thapa from Matia village had
                                                                                                                             been suffering from hypertension and chronic
                                                                                                                             body pain. A widowed mother living with her son, a
                                                                                                                             daily wage labourer, she found it difficult to meet
                                                                                                                             healthcare expenses. Regular medical check-ups
                                                                                                                             and medicines were beyond their reach, leaving her
                                                                                                                             condition unaddressed for years.
                                                                                                                             Her situation improved when the Guwahati Mobile
                                                                                                                             Health Unit (MHU) visited her village. For the first    feels stronger, more energetic, and manages her daily
                                                                                                                             time, Mrs. Thapa was able to consult a doctor           routine with greater ease.
                                                                                                                             without worrying about expenses or travel.              Deeply satisfied with the doctor’s care and quality
                                                                                                                             She received a proper medical assessment, along         of service, she expressed heartfelt gratitude to the
                                                                                                                             with prescribed medicines, which she has been           Guwahati MHU team. For her, the MHU is more than
                                                                                                                             taking regularly. The impact has been remarkable.       a health service; it is a lifeline that has restored her
                                                                                                                             Her body pain has reduced, her blood pressure is        well-being, reduced her financial burden, and brought
                                                                                                                             now stable, and she can sleep peacefully. She now       essential healthcare directly to the village.

                                                                                                                         5 Risk Management
                                                                                                                           and Controls
                                                                                                                                                   We follow sustainable tax practices with high governance. We identify tax
                                                                                                                                                   risks with the perspective that they may be avoided / mitigated. Our tax
                                                                                                                                                   governance framework focusses on how tax risks are identified, managed,
                                                                                                                                                   monitored and mitigated. Wherever significant positions are taken, we seek
                                                                                                                                                   advice from external experts / senior counsels. The key positions adopted
                                                                                                                                                   are appropriately documented along with the basis for the same.
                                                                                                                                                   Standard operating procedures are built for tax processes, with the
                                                                                                                                                   objective to follow uniform and standardised procedures. Material tax
                                                                                                                                                   matters are reported to the committee / sub-committee of Board of
                                                                                                                                                   Directors, as considered appropriate. Additionally, the Company has

                                                                                                                                                   report concerns about unethical or improper activities or any irregularities.
